patient_profile.diagnosis_summary: Adult male with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), currently prescribed Azstarys.

request.requested_disposition: Coverage approval for continued Azstarys for ADHD

denial_rationale: Insurer denied coverage, directing the patient to try generic preferred formulary alternatives (e.g., generic Adderall, Ritalin, or Focalin) before Azstarys would be covered.

known_facts.text: Patient has a diagnosis of ADHD.
Patient has been taking Azstarys 39.2 mg/7.8 mg per day for 1 month with reported good response.
Patient previously tried Ritalin, Adderall, Vyvanse, Strattera, and Wellbutrin for ADHD without prolonged reported efficacy.
Azstarys is FDA-approved for treatment of ADHD; the prescribed dose matches the recommended starting dose.

treatment_or_claim_history.description: Trials of Ritalin, Adderall, Vyvanse, Strattera, and Wellbutrin, each without prolonged reported efficacy.
Started Azstarys 39.2 mg/7.8 mg per day; reported good response.

available_evidence.description: Prescriber records documenting prior medication trials and outcomes
One month of reported clinical response data on Azstarys

unknowns: Whether the patient specifically trialed generic Focalin (dexmethylphenidate), the formulary alternative most pharmacologically similar to Azstarys.
Duration and dosing details of each prior medication trial.
